description: Hover over native Git changes, staged changes and files to see lines added and deleted.
title: Line Stats
presentation: Where to display line counts. Native hover cards are enabled automatically; reload the window after the first installation.
native: Integrate into native Git Changes and Staged Changes.
panel: Use a separate Line Stats view.
hover: Colored hover cards with lines added/deleted and a proportion bar (enabled automatically with Custom CSS and JS Loader).
inline: Always show line counts in the list.
untracked: Include untracked text files in added lines under Changes.
